repairs.issue: Quadratic causal-score recomputation made the first matrix run impractically slow; the initial summary also counted utility committed after a realized deadline overrun.
repairs.root_cause: Visible-prefix scores were recomputed independently for identical reset prefixes, and summary utility used terminal state rather than the last on-time durable ledger state.
repairs.claim_impact: Removed optimistic post-deadline utility and improved runtime only; frozen state, actions, outcomes, Frontier, policies, and costs were unchanged.
